content: अच्युत {%a.%} [<sab>न˚ त˚</sab> स्वरूपसामर्थ्यात् न च्युतः च्यवते वा-कालसामान्ये कर्तरि क्त] .²1 Not fallen, firm, fixed; not giving way, solid; गरुडमूर्तिरिव अच्युतस्थितिरमणीया <ls>K. 52</ls> (अच्युत meaning ‘Viṣṇu’ and ‘firm’, ‘fixed’); ˚क्षित् having solid ground. .²2 Imperishable, permanent; ˚रुष् inveterate enmity. .²3 [न च्योतति क्षरति; च्युत्-क. <sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] Not melting away or perishing, not leaking or dripping. .{@-तः@} .²1 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu; of the Almighty Being; यस्मान्न च्युतपूर्वोऽहमच्युतस्तेन कर्मणा <ls>Bhāg.</ls> .²2 गच्छाम्यच्युतदशनेन <ls>K. P. 5</ls>. (where अ˚ also means ‘one who is firm, does not yield to passions’) .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a plant, Morinda Tinctoria. (<lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>बारातोंडी, शिर्दोली</ns>). .²4 A sort of poetical composition containing 12 cantos.
